adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces the old PATCH-based membership changes (and deletes the incremental PATCH specs) with new endpoints `add_members`/`remove_member` in `Admin::GroupsController`. In `add_members`, `usernames.split(",").each` does not strip whitespace and silently ignores unknown usernames (`User.find_by_username` nil), so inputs like "alice, bob" will likely skip " bob". In `remove_member`, `group.users.delete(user_id)` will silently no-op if the user isn’t a member. The updated specs add only happy-path tests for adding/removing and an automatic-group restriction, but do not cover these edge cases, leaving previously-covered behavior (via the deleted PATCH tests) untested for the new code paths. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test/edge-case gap rather than a guaranteed defect.
